notes: Merged 'Plant cheese, firm' (k114) and 'Plant cheese, soft' (k115) into one 'Plant cheese' kind. Their formats became types: block, slices, grated, soft/spreadable and cultured nut cheese. All existing models were kept, since each list was already short (1–2 entries). I dropped the range 'Soyog' (Sichuan Lanjian Beverage Group) from Plant yoghurt. It is an obscure regional line that does not cover the market, and it looks like retail-harvest noise. As the shelf brief asked, I added leader brands as ranges rather than SKUs. Violife on Plant cheese is backed by that kind's existing source (violife.com). Alpro on Plant yoghurt has no source in this shelf's old data, so it should be checked against the Plant drinks shelf or the brand register before publishing. Oatly was already present as Oatgurt. Attribute variants (base, style, format, flavour) are listed as types, not kinds. Each kind keeps its old 's'. No archetypes, new kinds or brand-register entries were added.
